title: Spend Sculptor: timeline with rule-based export wizard
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Customers need an intuitive way to inspect token-level spend across time, attribute spend to actors (routes, models, teams), and export curated slices for billing or audits. Existing views are snapshot-oriented and heavy on tables; we lack an approachable timeline for exploration and a flexible export builder with rule-based filters.

Goal: Design a compact, interactive timeline view (Spend Sculptor) that surfaces per-token cost spikes, lets users sculpt time ranges and attribution rules (by route, model variant, user role, label), preview the resulting CSV/JSON shape, and persist export recipes as reusable templates. The export wizard should support rule logic (AND/OR), aggregation intervals, and SKU mapping.

Proposed solution:
- Primary canvas: horizontal time-series sparkline with stacked breakdown by attribution dimension; on hover, show per-token, per-route deltas and most-likely causation (model switch, batch size change).
- Sculpting interactions: lasso and range select, quick anchors for last 1h/24h/7d, and a compare-mode to diff two ranges.
- Rule-based export builder: stepper UI where users pick dimensions (route/model/team), set filters (includes/excludes, thresholds), choose aggregation (per-minute/per-session/per-request), map columns to billing SKUs, and preview sample rows.
- Templates & sharing: save recipes, attach to dashboards and alerts, or link to console policies. Recipes show last-run stats and a small preview.

Constraints and trade-offs: tight screen real-estate in the console list view means the timeline needs condensed micro-visuals with expandable detail. Export builder must be powerful but not overwhelming — progressive disclosure with an "advanced rules" panel. Accessibility and keyboard-first interactions are required for sculpting.

Success metrics:
- 30% reduction in time-to-export for audit-motivated customers (measured in user test tasks).
- 40% of exports created from templates within 3 months of launch.
- Usability score >= 80 on prototype tasks for rule creation and timeline selection.

Notes: tie to backend endpoints provided by ENG (ENG-90312 aggregation API + ENG-91400 template storage). Coordinate with PM for SKU mapping matrix (PM-440).
acceptance_criteria: Interactive timeline shows stacked per-token breakdown and updates on hover
Sculptor range selection exports a filtered sample preview
Export wizard supports AND/OR rule logic and SKU column mapping
Saved export recipes are listed and can be applied to dashboards
Design passes 3 moderated usability tasks with >80% task completion
